primary.version: Current Steam Early Access build with Summer Update
primary.why: Bellwright entered Steam Early Access in April 2024 and reached PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S in June 2026. Console versions are nearly identical, but console co-op was held back at launch and crossplay/dedicated servers were still in development. The Windows PC Steam build is therefore the safest archive route right now because it has the established Early Access branch, Workshop, co-op, and best capture/settings control.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam build and install the latest update before capture. Use console builds only after rechecking whether console co-op and crossplay have shipped.
